::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this step does

Mortality Step 3 reads the classified Step 2 data, calculates the approved mortality measures and creates a private data-package folder for Step 4.

It creates exact private values. It does not apply the final disclosure control, approve the data package, publish files or link DCO events.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
1. Run Step 3 for the same year and month as Steps 1–2.
2. Confirm `Completed successfully`.
3. Check the analysis years and row counts.
4. Confirm the datasets, supporting information and review files are present.
:::

## Before you start

- Complete Step 2 successfully for the same data release.
- Confirm the two private population reference files exist.
- Remember that the selected `YYYY_MM` identifies the data freeze. Step 3 separately derives the completed analysis years, beginning in 2010 and ending before the release year.

Step 3 carries both **Primary** and **Inclusive** mortality definitions. In generated data, `upper_clear_likely_possible` is the internal name for Inclusive; it is not a confidence limit or linkage estimate.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

| File | What Step 3 uses or checks |
|---|---|
| `$BNR_DATA_DERIVED/mortality/yYYYY/mMM/bnr_mort_s2_YYYYMM.dta` | Classified private mortality data from Step 2. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/reference/population/wpp2024_brb_population_2010_2035_5y.dta` | Approved private Barbados population denominators from UN World Population Prospects 2024. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/reference/population/who_world_standard_2000_2025.dta` | Fixed WHO World Standard Population weights used for direct age standardisation. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do` | Main Step 3 controller; run directly by the menu, dialog or command. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_calc.do` | Calculates the mortality reporting rows automatically. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_construct_rates.do` | Calculates annual crude and directly age-standardised rates automatically. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_stage.do` | Checks the calculated data and creates the Step 3 package automatically. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_mort_s3_burden.dlg` | Stata dialog for the year, month and replacement choice. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds Step 3 to the BNR Stata menu. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

Step 3 creates the private folder `$BNR_STAGING/mortality/burden/mort_YYYY_MM/`.

| File | What it contains or what to check |
|---|---|
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Exact private mortality measures labelled with the selected data release; Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | CSV copy of the exact data-release measures. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.dta` | Exact private measures using the stable filename; Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv` | CSV copy using the stable filename read by later processes. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_package.yml` | Generated description of the package, reporting scope and source. |
| `review/mort_burden_qa_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Results of the automated calculation and package checks. `qa` means quality assurance. |
| `review/mort_burden_suppression_review_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Private worklist used when Step 4 applies disclosure control. |
| `review/mort_burden_suppression_review_mort_YYYY_MM.xlsx` | Spreadsheet copy of the same Step 3 worklist. This is not the Step 4 human-review workbook. |
| `readme.txt` | Short private guide to the package. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_mort_s3_burden_mort_YYYY_MM.log` | Private run log. |

Do not edit any generated package file.

:::

## Measures prepared by Step 3

| Metric | What it contains |
|---|---|
| `MORT-BURDEN-001` | Mortality counts and approved rolling-comparison rows. |
| `MORT-BURDEN-002` | Annual percentage distributions. |
| `MORT-RATE-001` | Annual crude and directly age-standardised mortality rates per 100,000. |

Annual rates cover All CVD, Heart and Stroke; both sexes, women and men; and crude and directly age-standardised forms. Step 3 supplies 95% confidence intervals: exact Poisson/Garwood intervals for crude rates and Fay–Feuer gamma intervals for age-standardised rates. The dashboard displays these supplied rows and must not recalculate rates or intervals.

The proposed public monthly scope is All CVD, both sexes, all ages and monthly count. Quarterly and annual rows include the additional approved event-type and sex detail; annual All-CVD rows also include the approved broad age groups.

## Run Step 3

1. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Update CVD mortality dashboard > Step 3: Build mortality burden data**.
2. Enter the same year and month used in Steps 1–2, leave replacement unticked for the first run, and select **Run Step 3**.
3. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do" 2026 7
   ```

4. For a deliberate rebuild, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do" 2026 7 replace
   ```

5. In `MORTALITY STEP 3: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: Completed successfully`.
6. Check the reported first and final analysis years and the metric row counts.
7. Confirm all files listed above are present in `mort_YYYY_MM/`.
8. Continue to Step 4. Do not treat the Step 3 suppression-review spreadsheet as the completed human review.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If Step 3 does not complete"}

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| The matching Step 2 DTA is missing | Complete Steps 1–2 for the same year and month; do not substitute a differently dated file. |
| A population reference file is missing or fails its checks | Restore the approved reference file. Do not replace it with an unapproved download or edit generated rates. |
| Existing Step 3 files block an authorised rebuild | Use the complete `replace` command. Step 3 removes any earlier `public_ready` approval for that data release, so Step 4 review and Step 5 approval must be repeated. |

Read `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_mort_s3_burden_mort_YYYY_MM.log` before acting. For other problems, see [Troubleshoot the workflow](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).

:::
